summary_1line: Bhishma belittles Karna as only half a warrior; Drona agrees, provoking Karna’s furious rebuttal and vow not to fight while Bhishma commands.

image_candidates.scene_text: Karna, eyes blazing with rage, points accusingly at the aged Bhishma in the royal war council as armored kings watch in tense silence.
Bhishma, white-haired and calm in shining armor, dismissively declares Karna only half a warrior before the gathered Kuru commanders.
Karna vows before Duryodhana that he will not enter the war until Bhishma falls, his hand gripping his bow while the court murmurs.
